definitions.de: An etwas riechen oder schnüffeln; den Geruch von etwas wahrnehmen
definitions.en: To smell or sniff something; to perceive the scent of something using the nose
definitions.es: Oler o olfatear algo; percibir el aroma de algo con la nariz
definitions.fr: Sentir ou renifler quelque chose; percevoir l'odeur de quelque chose avec le nez
definitions.hi: किसी चीज़ को सूंघना; नाक से किसी चीज़ की गंध को महसूस करना
definitions.ja: 何かにおいをかぐ、または嗅ぐ；鼻で何かの香りを感じる
definitions.km: ស្ដាប់ក្លិន ឬស្ទុះក្លិនអ្វីមួយ; ដឹងពីក្លិនរបស់អ្វីមួយតាមច្រមុះ
definitions.ko: 무언가 냄새를 맡다 또는 코로 킁킁거리다; 코로 냄새를 감지하다
definitions.ne: केही चीजको गन्ध लिनु वा सुँघ्नु; नाकले गन्ध महसुस गर्नु
definitions.pt: Cheirar ou farejar algo; perceber o aroma de algo com o nariz
definitions.th: ดม; สูดกลิ่นหรือสูดอากาศเพื่อรับรู้กลิ่นของบางสิ่ง
definitions.tl: Amuin o ngimutin ang isang bagay; maramdaman ang amoy ng isang bagay gamit ang ilong
definitions.ur: کسی چیز کو سونگھنا؛ ناک سے کسی چیز کی خوشبو یا بدبو محسوس کرنا
definitions.vi: Ngửi hoặc hít hương thơm của thứ gì đó; cảm nhận mùi của thứ gì đó bằng mũi
definitions.zh: 闻或嗅某物；用鼻子感知某物的气味
definitions.zh_Hant: 聞或嗅某物；用鼻子感知某物的氣味

definition_en: To smell or sniff something; to perceive the scent of something using the nose
